::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [22 November 1868]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 222-3
:::

My dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd),
Many, many thanks[.]  the birthday[^1] for which the [Heroes](other_books/otherbook_358.qmd) were wanted comes tomorrow, so nothing can be more convenient. The [Lances](cmy_books/cmybook_23.qmd) look very well

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: CMY’s nephew, [Francis Arthur Yonge](people/person_1607.qmd) was going to be seven on 23 November 1868.
